Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: In step 2, the Planner incorrectly identifies the father-in-law of Maria Luisa Teresa Luisa of Savoy (Princesse de Lamballe) as Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, Duke of Penthièvre, instead of the correct figure, Louis de Bourbon-Toulouse, Duke of Penthièvre. This mistake is carried forward in subsequent steps, leading to confusion in identifying the correct father-in-law.
